name: Phone on a visor bracket, no lenses (single full-screen view)
notes: The phone is strapped on top of the head or to a cap/visor with the screen tilted toward the eyes; the back camera looks ahead and slightly down. The patient reads the screen like a normal display, so no stereo split and no barrel distortion. The camera image keeps its true aspect (cropped, never stretched), the plumb line and horizon are gravity-locked, and Mode B rotates the picture about the screen centre. overscan 1.0 keeps the whole field of view; raise it to hide the grey corners that appear during large Mode B rotations.
